snippet.title: Witch of Eclipse - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
After Liz graduates and becomes a full-fledged magic wielder, Liz leaves her village and sets off to the vast world outside. Little did she know, she may be the reincarnation of the Witch of Eclipse–the very woman who saved the world from a great threat in the past.
